seo.title: Habit Stacking — Chain Habits Together for Better Results | Momentum
seo.description: Use Momentum's habit stacking feature to chain habits together. Based on the Atomic Habits technique — after X, I do Y — built into your schedule.
seo.keywords: habit stacking, atomic habits stacking, chain habits together, habit stacking app, after I do X I do Y

hero.headline: Stack habits. Build chains. Stay consistent.
hero.subline: The habit stacking formula — 'After I [current habit], I will [new habit]' — is one of the most effective behaviour change techniques. Momentum makes it automatic.

sections.heading: What is habit stacking?
sections.body: Habit stacking is a technique popularised by James Clear in Atomic Habits. The idea is simple: instead of trying to remember a new habit on its own, you attach it to an existing one. 'After I pour my morning coffee, I will meditate for 2 minutes.' The existing habit becomes the cue for the new one.

sections.heading: How Momentum implements it
sections.body: When you create a moment in Momentum, you can define its cue — including linking it to another moment. The schedule then places them consecutively, and the UI shows the chain visually. You're not just tracking; you're designing the sequence.

sections.heading: Why it works
sections.body: Your brain is wired for sequences. Neural pathways for existing habits are already strong — by attaching new behaviours to them, you piggyback on that existing wiring. Over time the entire chain becomes automatic, like a morning routine you don't even think about.
